 import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

data = {
    'Year': [2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024],
    'Infrastructure Development': [8.2, 9.5, 10.3, 11.0, 11.8, 12.5, 15.2],
    'Public Healthcare': [5.1, 6.0, 6.8, 7.5, 8.1, 8.7, 10.1],
    'Education Reform': [4.0, 4.5, 5.1, 5.6, 6.0, 6.3, 7.8],
    'Transportation': [6.2, 7.0, 7.8, 8.3, 8.8, 9.2, 11.3],
    'Environmental Protection': [3.0, 3.5, 3.9, 4.2, 4.5, 4.8, 6.2],
    'Digital Transformation': [3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.3, 5.6, 6.9],
    'Social Welfare': [4.7, 5.2, 5.8, 6.3, 6.7, 7.1, 8.4],
    'National Security': [7.5, 8.2, 9.0, 9.5, 10.0, 10.4, 13.7]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
df_melted = df.melt('Year', var_name='Sector', value_name='Budget (B USD)')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 7))
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
sns.set_palette("husl")

ax = sns.lineplot(
    data=df_melted[df_melted['Sector'] != 'Environmental Protection'],
    x='Year',
    y='Budget (B USD)',
    hue='Sector',
    marker='o',
    markersize=8,
    linewidth=2.5
)

ax.set_title('Government Budget Allocation Trends by Sector (2018-2024)', fontsize=16, pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Sector', fontsize=12)
ax.set_xticks(df['Year'])
ax.set_xticklabels(df['Year'], fontsize=10)
ax.set_yticklabels(ax.get_yticks(), fontsize=10)

plt.legend(
    title='Government Sectors',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1),
    loc='upper left',
    fontsize=10,
    title_fontsize=11
)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.gca().set_ylim(2.39, 14.45)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
